findings.title: Design-batch resumes reject artifacts created by the original run
findings.description: A `slices-plan` item that created its design but exhausted review rounds is no longer selected by `cf.undesigned_slices`. Consequently, both retry and accept reject it instead of resolving its review. Reproduced with an open slice having a design file. The planning-batch test masks this by continuing to report the slice as undesigned. Resume selection must accommodate artifacts produced by the original attempt.

findings.title: Item resume mutates unregistered worktrees before checking registration
findings.description: Unlike `enter_slice_branch`, this precondition never calls the worktree-registration guard. It can therefore use the primary checkout’s integration target in an unregistered worktree. `restore_target` can stage and commit leftovers before checkout fails—or switch to the wrong target if available. Verify registration before any restoration, source evaluation, or reconciliation.

findings.title: Implementation-completion requirements incorrectly block planning retries
findings.description: Every resume requires dependencies to have CF status `complete`, including `tasks-plan` resumes. A dependency can have an acceptable design and tasks without being implemented; fresh planning runs permit this, but an item retry becomes flagged without running. The existing planning-resume tests contain no dependencies. Apply dependency readiness appropriate to the pipeline’s phase.

findings.title: New resume paths perform blocking I/O on the event loop
findings.description: Validation, git restoration, dependency queries, and report writes execute synchronously inside the coroutine. Git subprocesses can block for 30 seconds, while `ContextForgeClient._run` has no timeout. The new implementation source likewise calls synchronous CF methods directly. Move blocking work off-loop, bound subprocess duration, and test timeout observability and event-loop responsiveness.

findings.title: Malformed report items escape the documented validation error
findings.description: The `cast` does not validate JSON structure. A report containing `"items": [null]` raises `AttributeError` from `BatchItemRecord.from_json`, bypassing `BatchReportLoadError` and the controlled resume rejection. Reproduced directly against the loader. Validate the report and item shapes with Pydantic, including required fields and identity metadata, and add malformed-shape tests.
